subject: Split billing and prorated charges for Nov onboarding & premium support
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia@peacepay.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-23T09:18:00+01:00
Subject: Split billing for onboarding month and premium support add-on

Hi Markus / Laura,

We increased our active seats from 50 to 60 on Nov 10 as part of our onboarding ramp, and then added the Premium Support add-on on Nov 16. Our AP team (copying the PO) needs a clear breakdown for this partial month so they can post the charge against PO #8812 and close the period.

Could you confirm whether Redwood will:
- issue an adjustment invoice for the prorated seat increase (Nov 10–30) and the add-on (Nov 16–30), or
- apply a credit/charge on our next monthly invoice with a detailed line-item split?

We also need VAT handling information — we are Spain-based and will provide our EU VAT ID if that affects tax treatment. AP needs an invoice document (PDF) before Dec 1 to process this month’s close.

Attaching PO for reference: peacepay-PO-8812.pdf

Thanks,
Amelia Torres
Billing & Procurement
PeacePay, Inc.
amelia@peacepay.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@peacepay.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:05:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Split billing for onboarding month and premium support add-on

Hi Amelia — thanks for the PO and the heads up.

Short answer: we can issue an immediate adjustment invoice that itemizes the prorated seat increase and the prorated Premium Support add-on so your AP can post it to PO #8812. Alternatively, we can apply a one-line net charge on your next invoice; because you asked for a PDF before Dec 1, we recommend the adjustment invoice.

We’ll need your EU VAT number to determine whether to apply reverse-charge (B2B) or add VAT. If you can confirm VAT and whether the billing entity on the PO matches the VAT registration, I’ll loop in Finance to generate the invoice.

I’ve attached a quick estimate showing the math so you can confirm (estimate-prorate-Nov2026.xlsx). If those numbers look good, Finance will issue invoice RA-2026-1145 by end of day Nov 26.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive — Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference

From: Amelia Torres <amelia@peacepay.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:42:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Split billing for onboarding month and premium support add-on

Hi Laura —

Thanks, we prefer an immediate adjustment invoice. VAT details below: EU-VAT ID: ESB1234567. Billing entity on PO #8812 is PeacePay, Inc. (same as VAT). Remittance will be via bank transfer to benefit account; AP will confirm payment schedule once they receive the invoice.

Please go ahead.

—Amelia

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia@peacepay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T16:12:00+01:00
Subject: RE: Split billing for onboarding month and premium support add-on

Amelia —

Thanks for the VAT ID and confirmation. I verified ESB1234567 via VIES and confirmed the billing entity matches the PO. Because this is a B2B supply between two VAT-registered companies in the EU, we will apply reverse-charge and issue the invoice without Spanish VAT (VAT 0% — reverse charge). Please find the formal adjustment invoice attached: invoice-RA-2026-1145.pdf

Summary (line items):
- Seats (additional 10 seats): unit price €45/month. Prorated period Nov 10–30 (21 days of 30-day billing month). Calculation: 10 seats × €45 × (21/30) = €315.00
- Premium Support add-on (per-account): €1,200/month. Prorated period Nov 16–30 (15 days). Calculation: €1,200 × (15/30) = €600.00
- Subtotal: €915.00
- VAT: 0% (reverse charge, EU B2B) — VAT shown on invoice for reference but not charged
- Total (net): €915.00

Invoice details:
- Invoice number: RA-2026-1145
- Invoice date: 2026-11-26
- Due date (Net 30): 2026-12-26
- Payment instructions: Bank transfer to Redwood EU Clearing (IBAN: DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00). Please include RA-2026-1145 in the remittance reference.

If you need us to set an earlier due date to match internal AP schedules, we can accommodate upon request — otherwise we’ll keep Net 30 standard.

Attachments: invoice-RA-2026-1145.pdf (PDF - adjustment invoice)

Thanks — I’ll update the HubSpot deal (PP-2026-44) and the billing ticket (HB-3421) once payment is posted.

-Rishi
Finance — Redwood Inference
